opening.argument: The presentation combines specific high-income projections, including claims of $15,000 per day, $330,000 per month, and projected binary bonuses tied to time periods and team-member counts. Its visible NETWORKERS and binary-bonus tables connect financial freedom and potential earnings to sharing the business, recruiting, growing a team, and downline placement. The speaker says, “The Highly Effective people will generally share the business with someone every day. They will recruit” and states a “potential binary bonus per week US$3232.” Viewers are directed to join MTI or contact the sender for more information. Although the presentation says bonuses depend on trading results and includes non-guarantee language, the available evidence does not establish actual earnings, required enrollment payments, completed transactions, or subsequent outcomes.
